newsitem.title: USA: Park National says First Knox merger cleared.
newsitem.headline: Park National says First Knox merger cleared.

text.p: Park National Corp on Thursday said the Federal Reserve Board and the Ohio Division of Financial Institutions have approved its proposed merger with First Knox Banc Corp.
Park National said all bank regulatory approvals have now been received within the original time frames expected.

Terms of the merger will be sent to both Park and First-Knox stockholders within the next week in connection with Park's annual meeting, scheduled for April 21, 1997, and First-Knox's special meeting scheduled for April 23, 1997, Park National said.
